d: Olive-brown hair is styled in a high bun with short, blunt-cut bangs and a soft texture. The eyes are a deep amethyst purple with a wide, innocent expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build is dressed in a blue and white dress featuring a high collar, white apron, a pale yellow underskirt, and a blue-and-white checkered lining, paired with white thigh-high stockings and brown shoes. A floating, ornate dark brown leather book with glowing pages and silver metallic accents serves as the primary accessory.
